title: Building Emotional Intelligence
coreMove: Emotional intelligence turns sensation into data: notice the body, separate the story, identify the need, then choose a deliberate response.

exampleSpecs.audience: ambitious readers who feel threatened by success
exampleSpecs.stakes: a wanted outcome may be abandoned because the body reads arrival as danger
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show wanting and enjoying separating after a real achievement

exampleSpecs.audience: people who reject attention they privately want
exampleSpecs.stakes: visibility may feel morally unsafe because of old judgments
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show subconscious association making a desired outcome feel bad

exampleSpecs.audience: readers drawn to quick biological reset stories
exampleSpecs.stakes: a comforting slogan could replace careful emotional interpretation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use the NPR correction to avoid simplistic identity claims

exampleSpecs.audience: builders who treat new ambition as failure to be content
exampleSpecs.stakes: restlessness after a win can push a leader into needless escalation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show desire renewing after acquisition without making ambition the villain

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose goals clash with inherited meanings
exampleSpecs.stakes: a desired raise may feel unsafe because money was morally judged
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show a rational goal blocked by old subconscious associations

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who treat a current mood as fixed identity
exampleSpecs.stakes: temporary heaviness may be mistaken for a permanent verdict
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show changeability without vague biology folklore
